_about: Limits for the real style's ambient occlusion, for tools/look.mjs --check (npm run check:ao, which also runs tools/ao_check.mjs): the canopy of the wood is darker inside and not black, the city's buildings do not shimmer more, the far land is left alone. A rule: { shot, metric, min, max }.

rules.why: the dark half of the trees' light against the lit half stays under 0.45 and the occlusion does not raise it much: the crowd inside the canopy is darker, not lighter (0.4328 with the leaves of cut-out cards and the sun's shadow on the crowns, 0.4023 before them)
the canopy's darkest hundredth stays a dark green and not a black clump: L 0.0734 without the occlusion, 0.0672 with it
the buildings' light changes from one frame to the next by no more than 1.1 times what it does without the occlusion (0.07649; 0.0765 with it), driving past: the noise does not crawl
the far land (past 1500 m) keeps its light to 1%: it has none of the occlusion (L 0.6343 without it, 0.6343 with it)
